CREATE TABLE teacher_context_summary (
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    context_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    context_id UUID NOT NULL,
    covered_from_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (covered_from_sequence > 0),
    covered_through_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (covered_through_sequence >= covered_from_sequence),
    digest_from_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (digest_from_sequence >= covered_from_sequence),
    digest_through_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (
        digest_through_sequence >= digest_from_sequence
        AND digest_through_sequence <= covered_through_sequence
    ),
    digest_event_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (digest_event_sequence >= digest_through_sequence),
    source_digest CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (source_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    summary_json JSONB NOT NULL,
    schema_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    invalidated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    PRIMARY KEY (student_id, personal_teacher_id, dialog_id, context_type, context_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id)
        REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CHECK (btrim(student_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (context_type IN ('general', 'lesson', 'lesson_task', 'practice_task', 'project')),
    CHECK (
        (context_type = 'general' AND context_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
        OR
        (context_type <> 'general' AND context_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
    ),
    CHECK (schema_code = 'teacher.context-summary.v1'),
    CHECK (policy_version = 'teacher-context-summary-policy-v1'),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(summary_json) = 'object'),
    CHECK (summary_json ?& ARRAY[
        'schema','summary','understood_observations','open_difficulties','assistance_observations','next_focus'
    ]),
    CHECK (summary_json - ARRAY[
        'schema','summary','understood_observations','open_difficulties','assistance_observations','next_focus'
    ] = '{}'::jsonb),
    CHECK (summary_json ->> 'schema' = schema_code),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'summary') = 'string'),
    CHECK (octet_length(summary_json ->> 'summary') BETWEEN 1 AND 16000),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'understood_observations') = 'array'),
    CHECK (jsonb_array_length(summary_json -> 'understood_observations') <= 8),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'open_difficulties') = 'array'),
    CHECK (jsonb_array_length(summary_json -> 'open_difficulties') <= 8),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'assistance_observations') = 'array'),
    CHECK (jsonb_array_length(summary_json -> 'assistance_observations') <= 8),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'next_focus') = 'array'),
    CHECK (jsonb_array_length(summary_json -> 'next_focus') <= 8),
    CHECK (octet_length(summary_json::text) <= 131072),
    CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
    CHECK (invalidated_at IS NULL OR invalidated_at >= created_at)
);

CREATE INDEX teacher_context_summary_dialog_idx
    ON teacher_context_summary (dialog_id, covered_through_sequence)
    WHERE invalidated_at IS NULL;
